registration.statement: One Fold distinction supplies the native information unit. Across k canonical positions, the complete generated held-label word family supplies the exact branch support corresponding to a finite quantum basis support, and complete pair cells supply joint-state support. Calling this support superposition-equivalent asserts equality of enumerated alternatives and provenance only: amplitudes, phase and dynamics are not imported. Observation returns an exact retained branch class and a complete reconstruction record. Thus classical held states, probabilistic observation classes and quantum basis support share one exact information carrier at this boundary.
